note: Every model or response FARIS reports, with the verification evidence behind it. A model that reports numbers names the Rust output catalogues (pub const NAME: &[Output]) that list them; `python3 -m validation models` reads those catalogues, so a calculated output added in Rust without a row here, or a catalogue no model claims, fails the lint. Validation evidence is never written here: it is derived from validation/matrix.json. Each evidence item has exactly one class (verification, code-to-code, experiment, plant-reproduction). Every test or control named here must exist.

models.label: Fixed-source neutron and photon transport (OpenMC adapter) and its normalisation to per-second, per-volume and per-source-neutron values

verification.name: power_and_units_scale_exactly_and_cm3_equals_m3
verification.what: unit and power scaling of the tally conversion is exact

verification.name: regional_fast_flux_normalizes_per_region_volume_with_volume_error
verification.what: regional flux normalisation divides by the region volume and carries its error

verification.name: test_exact_values_and_path_length_identity
verification.what: one-group pure-absorber sphere against its analytic answer

verification.name: test_each_seeded_unit_slip_is_detected
verification.what: an independent recomputation of the conversion table catches seeded unit slips

not_covered: transport physics itself: OpenMC and the nuclear data library are external and are not verified by these tests
photon heating and dose responses
any geometry that is not a recorded run

models.label: Transport on an authored CAD design: source, variance reduction, flux and fluence limits, and all-energy component/H3 rates for the shared operating-history model

verification.name: flux_conversion_has_the_right_units

verification.name: a_total_fluence_limit_scores_all_energies
verification.what: a total fluence limit scores all energies

verification.name: loaded_cad_history_rates_must_match_scenario_hash_id_and_power
verification.what: CAD history rates bind the scenario identity and D-T normalization power

verification.name: history_component_map_is_a_complete_unique_partition_with_blanket_breeder
verification.what: CAD history components cover each material-bearing solid exactly once

not_covered: the transport physics of the external solver
variance-reduction bias against an analog run on a plant-scale design

models.label: Operating history: fuel, decay, processing, exposure, replacement and energy over the plant life

verification.name: decay_only_history_matches_half_life_and_is_daily_decimated
verification.what: tritium decay against the analytic half-life

verification.name: demountable_history_with_perturbed_rates_conserves_tritium
verification.what: tritium is conserved through replacement events with perturbed rates

verification.name: test_recorded_engine_histories_close_in_decimals
verification.what: independent decimal recomputation of recorded engine histories

not_covered: tritium permeation, losses to structures and processing efficiency beyond the authored inputs
agreement with a plant or a published fuel-cycle code

models.label: Brief summaries and study comparisons built from a history and a transport record

verification.name: every_field_of_the_summaries_is_classed
verification.what: every numeric field of a summary is classed as calculated or not

verification.name: contrast_is_second_minus_first
verification.what: the contrast of two cases is the second minus the first

not_covered: the summaries add no physics; they restate the history and transport records and inherit their validation state

models.label: Independent numerical controls: the pure-absorber sphere and the coupled lithium capture control

verification.name: test_exact_values_and_path_length_identity
verification.what: analytic pure-absorber answer
lithium capture control checker

not_covered: a narrow chain only: source setup, one group, tally conversion; it says nothing about energy-dependent physics

verification.name: drawn_moments_match_mean_and_covariance

verification.name: identical_for_any_thread_count

models.label: Computed maintenance durations and cooldown

verification.name: cooldown_matches_the_reference
verification.what: cooldown against a reference computation

verification.name: calibrated_loop_converges_and_lengthens_cooldowns_with_age

shutdown dose governed durations use a separate spatial-dose maintenance model

models.label: Dose-governed replacement cooldown from exact event, history and task-location bound external estimates
models.reports: authored replacement durations from event-specific ICRP-116 AP photon effective dose curves at a named task location; curves can be imported or produced by either the bounded legacy OpenMC continuous-energy R2S route or the optional configured FISPACT-709 neutron-response → native Rust ACTINV → OpenMC photon route after checked CAD preparation. The ACTINV route uses exact per-component installation histories and marks D1S NOT_EVALUATED; the continuous-energy D1S/R2S comparison is only available for compatible common-history inputs and adequate chain-data coverage

verification.name: only_exact_history_event_design_and_location_curve_is_selectable
verification.what: event curves bind exact histories, design inputs, installations, task locations, input artifact bytes and run-record identities; changing the outer event hash cannot relabel a historical run

verification.name: central_ratio_outside_band_never_passes_validation
verification.what: out-of-band central D1S/R2S ratios are refused and missing covariance remains inconclusive

verification.name: preparation_and_r2s_receipt_headers_bind_schema_status_and_request
verification.what: worker receipts must match the supported schema, successful status where applicable, and exact request digest

verification.name: spatial_dose_parser_fixtures_cover_valid_curve_and_result_and_reject_malformed_versions
verification.what: valid synthetic curve/result fixtures reach both parsers and wrong schema/governing-quantity fixtures are rejected

not_covered: the configured ACTINV-709 backend produces R2S dose curves but does not produce a compatible continuous-energy D1S estimate; its D1S comparison is NOT_EVALUATED

the legacy continuous-energy D1S/R2S path is restricted to compatible common irradiation histories; heterogeneous component installation histories cannot share stock nuclide-global D1S time factors and remain NOT_EVALUATED unless qualified estimates are imported
the OpenMC R2S provider is bounded to checked static CAD geometry and its authored per-solid component/material map with event-specific irradiation; it is not a general evolving-geometry model
no independent transport or facility benchmark validates imported or generated dose estimates
source-resolution convergence and crossing-time uncertainty are not established

models.label: Geometry checks on an authored design: closure, overlaps, slivers, volumes
models.reports: findings with measured sizes (gaps, overlaps, volumes), not a calculated quantity of the registry

verification.name: sampled_volumes_agree_with_exact_volumes
verification.what: sampled volumes against exact volumes

verification.name: overlapping_solids_are_found_by_triangles_sampling_and_chords
verification.what: seeded overlaps are found by three independent methods

not_covered: tolerances are authored, with no equations behind them

models.label: Comparison of imported spatial D1S and R2S shutdown-dose estimates

verification.name: reports_ratio_and_propagates_error_only_under_explicit_assumption
verification.what: ratio arithmetic and error propagation under a declared independence assumption

verification.name: covariance_unknown_is_inconclusive_even_when_seed_labels_differ
verification.what: different stream labels alone do not establish independence

verification.name: estimate_value_tampering_is_rejected_even_when_outer_hash_is_updated
verification.what: the imported estimate must match the hash-verified source record

not_covered: no solver is executed
record hashes establish identity, not scientific correctness
no experimental validation or handling-dose qualification
a central ratio-band flag is not a physical engineering verdict

models.label: Separate coupled, all-energy heating tallies for explicitly authored winding-pack solids, with sampled peak power density

verification.name: two_volumes_scale_density_and_sampling_error_independently
verification.what: independent dimensional control: equal raw energy and source rate produce peak density and sampling error inversely proportional to the sampled averaging volume

verification.name: worker_parser_preserves_failed_correlated_closure_and_terminal_controls
verification.what: worker JSON retains a failed correlated-closure diagnostic and checks terminal status against planned histories

verification.name: test_fake_openmc_phase_writes_raw_report_for_engine_parser
verification.what: fake C API drives the worker batch loop and raw report, including total/component filters, source normalization, volume selection and inconclusive closure preservation

verification.name: test_terminal_quality_checks_status_and_lost_count_even_for_short_runs
verification.what: terminal C API codes and strict final lost-particle fraction gate short and full runs

not_covered: OpenMC transport physics and nuclear-data correctness are external; this path has no experimental or code-to-code physical validation and does not establish a requirement as met
the peak is the leading sampled cylindrical voxel; unresolved sub-voxel hotspots may be higher
the sampled geometry volume estimator reports its ray count but not a volume standard error; geometric volume uncertainty remains separate and is not folded into Monte Carlo heating error
an explicit authored winding-pack classification is required; magnet roles, cases and homogenized assemblies are not inferred to be winding pack
missing MT=301, photon or atomic-relaxation data and missing winding-pack identity produce NOT_EVALUATED rather than an inferred result
